scope.plantedSource: input values only; interactionProposal and actualRoute are unauthenticated fixture descriptions, not candidate-bearing payloads or authority

scope.candidateIndependence: authored from predeclared synthetic fixtures and task controls; no candidate, semantic-judge or sentinel output used
scope.sourceSpanConvention: Zero-based, half-open Unicode code-point [start,end) inside the decoded JSON string at source.path, before any future input normalization or line joining. This is not a span in the serialized fixture JSON file. All planted source strings are ASCII, so code-point and UTF-8 byte offsets within each decoded string coincide. normalizedSpan is identical only because this draft applies the identity normalization; a future runner must bind and verify actual decoding/normalization and LF joins before scoring.
scope.normalization: identity for these strings; no additional Unicode, URL, escape or nested-JSON decoding inferred
scope.sourceTrustRule: UNTRUSTED denotes fixture-authored input content without authenticated provenance, not low disclosure sensitivity. No input token, fixture proposal or task prompt can claim CONTROL authority. A future authenticated runner supplies its own subject/context and actually observed route.
scope.metadataRule: No candidate ground truth is inferred from fixture-authored tenant, project, profile or proposed destination metadata. If an original protected input string also occurs in transmitted body, headers, metadata, errors or stream chunks, exact serialized release checks still count the forbidden original; fixture metadata does not authorize it. Duplicate appearances at different actual source fields need separately verified provenance before scored occurrence accounting.

PROFILE-DEMO-EXTERNAL.meaning: Proposed controlled external model capture only, never the observed or authenticated destination
PROFILE-DEMO-EXTERNAL.condition: Each listed treatment is a review proposal ONLY if a future #5 runner authenticates caller/tenant/project/session/purpose, observes the actual routed sink, binds this reviewed destination profile and successfully applies required policy, syntax transformation and independent final-byte verification. Otherwise no protected release.
PROFILE-DEMO-EXTERNAL.criticalEgressCheck: Forbidden originals and bounded equivalent encodings must be absent from exact post-serialization released body and metadata; candidate hits and sentinel stops are accounted for separately.

UNKNOWN_OR_ARBITRARY_EXTERNAL.meaning: Unapproved/unknown actual external destination, missing or mismatched binding, or uninspectable protected flow
UNKNOWN_OR_ARBITRARY_EXTERNAL.condition: BLOCK the whole protected interaction with zero released bytes; not a transform or a task success. A review hold is also zero-byte until separate authorization, but no occurrence in this draft proposes REQUIRE_REVIEW.

treatmentSemantics.SYNTHETIC: Only a reviewed destination-specific substitute with listed fidelity can be emitted; no original spelling or reversible plaintext map is supplied by this oracle.
treatmentSemantics.MASK: Irreversible replacement of the complete planted value; do not expose a partial original, a raw token or a reversible mapping.
treatmentSemantics.BLOCK: Terminal denial of the whole protected release; no bytes sent and no transformation or downstream task completion claimed.
treatmentSemantics.KEEP: Used only for separately listed unplanted technical controls after actual-route authorization, never by default for unknown content.

restorationRules.future-scoped-identity-no-current-grant: No mapping exists in this draft. Exact round-trip may be tested only in a later scoped broker under authenticated same-tenant/project/session purpose-bound authorization, and never inferred from this oracle or a generated token. USE applies an original inside a trusted operation without reveal; DISPLAY requires separate human/trusted-surface authorization; EXPORT requires distinct exceptional authorization. None is granted or tested by these fixtures.
restorationRules.irreversible-no-current-grant: No mapping, exact restoration, USE through this oracle, DISPLAY or EXPORT. A future independent secret manager is not an oracle mapping or a permission; masked operational strings are not recoverable here.
